Pulse for 24 October 2026

The stories from 24 October 2026 in the Pulse of the Sapaude app, in our own words. Terms you don’t know are explained in the glossary. Glossary

AI agents

Get tasks done by text

A text-message agent is a piece of software you reach the way you text a person, and it tries to finish a chore such as a booking, a reminder, or an email instead of only talking about it.

Study

AI help can stall learning

A three-month experiment with 133 patent attorneys found that an AI writing assistant lifts beginners the most, yet once the tool is gone only the experienced keep an edge.

Study

Fancy coding AI costs more

A coding agent is a chat model plus the software wrapper around it, and a new study finds that a heavier wrapper barely changes how often the bug is fixed while the token bill can triple.

New model

AI learned to talk by ear

Block's research team built Dessa, a voice model that skips text entirely and, the company says, learned to hold a conversation only by listening to people talk.

Study

No AI profit outside tech

A financial payoff is the gain that shows up as higher revenue per worker or a wider profit margin, and Apollo's chief economist says he does not see it outside seven tech giants.
